title: GroupCreateInput
description: The fields that can be specified when creating a group.

unique_id.description:
Applies to SAML, OAuth2 and Proxied authentication when
the setting `GroupsByUniqueId` is enabled. This field
must not be present otherwise.

gid.description:
The POSIX Group ID (GID) for
[current user execution](../admin/process-management/index.md#runas-current).
Only administrators can set this field, and only when using
SAML or OAuth2 authentication. Must be a positive integer
and unique across all groups.
